name: Art
description: Create and edit images or generate short videos with Cindy's media capabilities. You can also invoke it directly with $cindy-art.
whenToUse: Use this plugin to create images, illustrations, avatars, posters, or other artwork; edit a generated image by adding elements or changing its style; generate a short video; or animate a still image.

gen_image.description: Prepare ordinary parameters for text-to-image creation. The current Agent then calls Cindy Core media and uses import_artwork to add successful results to the gallery.

edit_image.description: Prepare ordinary parameters to edit, redraw, stylize, or combine up to four source images. The current Agent then calls Cindy Core media and uses import_artwork to add successful results to the gallery.

gen_video.description: Prepare ordinary parameters for text-to-video creation. The current Agent then calls Cindy Core media and uses import_artwork to add successful results to the gallery.

edit_video.description: Prepare ordinary parameters for image-to-video creation: one reference image is the first frame and two represent the first and last frames. The current Agent then calls Cindy Core media and imports successful results into the gallery.

import_artwork.description: After Cindy Core media succeeds, add one authorized managed-media result to the Art gallery without generating it or rendering it again in chat.
